query:
SELECT 
  c.nome, 
  fc.mes, fc.ano,
  fc.totalServicos, fc.totalProdutos, fc.totalGeral,
  fc.qtdServicos, fc.qtdProdutos,
  LEFT(fc.detalhesServicos, 200) as detalhesServicos_sample
FROM faturamentoColaboradores fc
JOIN colaboradores c ON c.id = fc.colaboradorId
WHERE fc.mes IN (2, 3) AND fc.ano = 2026
ORDER BY c.nome, fc.mes
LIMIT 20;
